scope: Pediatric antibiotic regimens by syndrome; source-verified entries only
rule: Do not use this registry as a universal antibiotic table. The syndrome module selects the regimen. Dose/volume automation is allowed only for entries with explicit source dosing.

entries.syndrome: suspected community-acquired sepsis, age up to 17 years, non-neonatal pathway
entries.source: NICE NG51 full guideline: ceftriaxone 80 mg/kg once daily, max 4 g/day for people up to 17 years; <3 months add Listeria-active antibiotic

entries.syndrome: severe community-acquired pneumonia, age 3 months to 17 years
entries.duration: 5 days unless clinically unstable or microbiology indicates longer

entries.syndrome: severe community-acquired pneumonia with atypical pathogen suspected, age 1 month to 11 years
lower UTI, age 3 months to 11 years, low resistance risk
lower UTI, age 3 months to 11 years, eGFR >=45 mL/min
entries.source: NICE NG109: 750 micrograms/kg four times daily

entries.syndrome: lower UTI, second choice, age 3 months to 11 years
entries.frequency: twice daily where weight-based option applies

entries.syndrome: acute pyelonephritis, age 3 months to 11 years
acute pyelonephritis, age 3 months to 11 years and <=50 kg, severe/unable oral
cellulitis/erysipelas, age 1 month to 17 years, IV when unable oral or severely unwell
entries.duration: 5 to 7 days total with review/step-down as appropriate

entries.syndrome: cellulitis/erysipelas alternative regimen when co-amoxiclav is appropriate, age 3 months to 17 years
